data.name: Unseat (Mythic)
data.description: You knock your opponents down from their mounts with frightening concussive force.

raw_tokens.value: You knock your opponents down from their mounts with frightening concussive force.

When you successfully bull rush an opponent off his mount with Unseat, your opponent takes %1d6 points of falling damage. Items or abilities that reduce falling damage, such as a successful Acrobatics check, can reduce the damage dealt by the impact.|HalfMythicLevel
